instruction: Create an S3 bucket with versioning
output: echo 'bucket = aws.s3.Bucket("data", versioning=aws.s3.BucketVersioningArgs(enabled=True))' > __main__.py

instruction: Create an S3 bucket notification for Lambda
output: echo 'notification = aws.s3.BucketNotification("notif", bucket=bucket.id, lambda_functions=[aws.s3.BucketNotificationLambdaFunctionArgs(lambda_function_arn=fn.arn, events=["s3:ObjectCreated:*"])])' > __main__.py

instruction: Create a CloudFront distribution with custom origin
output: echo 'cdn = aws.cloudfront.Distribution("cdn", enabled=True, origins=[aws.cloudfront.DistributionOriginArgs(domain_name=lb.dns_name, origin_id="alb", custom_origin_config=aws.cloudfront.DistributionOriginCustomOriginConfigArgs(http_port=80, https_port=443, origin_protocol_policy="https-only"))], default_cache_behavior=aws.cloudfront.DistributionDefaultCacheBehaviorArgs(target_origin_id="alb", viewer_protocol_policy="redirect-to-https", allowed_methods=["GET", "HEAD"], cached_methods=["GET", "HEAD"]))' > __main__.py

instruction: Create a DynamoDB table with autoscaling
output: echo 'table = aws.dynamodb.Table("data", attributes=[aws.dynamodb.TableAttributeArgs(name="id", type="S")], hash_key="id", billing_mode="PROVISIONED", read_capacity=5, write_capacity=5); read_target = aws.appautoscaling.Target("read-dynamo", max_capacity=100, min_capacity=5, resource_id=f"table/{table.name}", scalable_dimension="dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits", service_namespace="dynamodb")' > dynamo.py

instruction: Create an SQS dead-letter queue
output: echo 'dlq = aws.sqs.Queue("dlq"); queue = aws.sqs.Queue("main", redrive_policy=aws.sqs.QueueRedrivePolicyArgs(max_receive_count=5, dead_letter_target_arn=dlq.arn))' > sqs.py

instruction: Create an SNS topic with filter policy
output: echo 'topic = aws.sns.Topic("alerts"); sub = aws.sns.TopicSubscription("high-pri", topic=topic.arn, protocol="lambda", endpoint=fn.arn, filter_policy=json.dumps({"priority":["critical","high"]}))' > sns.py

instruction: Create an IAM policy with multiple statements
output: echo 'policy = aws.iam.Policy("custom", policy=json.dumps({"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"*"}]}))' > iam.py

instruction: Attach a managed policy to a role
output: echo 'attachment = aws.iam.RolePolicyAttachment("s3-read", role=role.name, policy_arn="arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess")' > iam-attach.py

instruction: Create a KMS key with alias
output: echo 'key = aws.kms.Key("app"); alias = aws.kms.Alias("app", target_key_id=key.key_id, name="alias/app-key")' > kms.py

instruction: Create a Secrets Manager secret with rotation
output: echo 'secret = aws.secretsmanager.Secret("db", name="prod/db/password", rotation_rules=aws.secretsmanager.SecretRotationRulesArgs(automatically_after_days=30))' > secrets.py

instruction: Create an SSM parameter hierarchy
output: echo 'param = aws.ssm.Parameter("config", name="/app/prod/api_url", type="String", value="https://api.example.com")' > ssm.py

instruction: Create an EBS volume and attach to instance
output: echo 'vol = aws.ebs.Volume("data", availability_zone=instance.availability_zone, size=100); att = aws.ec2.VolumeAttachment("data-attach", volume_id=vol.id, instance_id=instance.id, device_name="/dev/xvdf")' > ebs.py

instruction: Create an ALB with HTTPS listener
output: echo 'lb = aws.lb.LoadBalancer("web", internal=False, security_groups=[sg.id], subnets=[subnet.id]); tg = aws.lb.TargetGroup("web", port=80, protocol="HTTP", vpc_id=vpc.id); listener = aws.lb.Listener("https", load_balancer_arn=lb.arn, port=443, protocol="HTTPS", certificate_arn=cert.arn, default_actions=[aws.lb.ListenerDefaultActionArgs(type="forward", target_group_arn=tg.arn)])' > alb.py

instruction: Create a WAF v2 web ACL
output: echo 'waf = aws.wafv2.WebAcl("main", default_action=aws.wafv2.WebAclDefaultActionArgs(allow={}), scope="REGIONAL", visibility_config=aws.wafv2.WebAclVisibilityConfigArgs(cloudwatch_metrics_enabled=True, metric_name="waf-main", sampled_requests_enabled=True), rules=[aws.wafv2.WebAclRuleArgs(name="rate-limit", priority=1, action=aws.wafv2.WebAclRuleActionArgs(block={}), statement=aws.wafv2.WebAclRuleStatementArgs(rate_based_statement=aws.wafv2.WebAclRuleStatementRateBasedStatementArgs(limit=2000, aggregate_key_type="IP")))])' > waf.py

instruction: Create a CloudWatch dashboard
output: echo 'dashboard = aws.cloudwatch.Dashboard("main", dashboard_name="InfraOverview", dashboard_body=json.dumps({"widgets":[{"type":"metric","properties":{"metrics":[["AWS/EC2","CPUUtilization"]],"period":300,"stat":"Average","region":"us-east-1","title":"EC2 CPU"}}]}))' > dashboard.py

instruction: Create a CloudWatch alarm
output: echo 'alarm = aws.cloudwatch.MetricAlarm("high-cpu", comparison_operator="GreaterThanThreshold", evaluation_periods=2, metric_name="CPUUtilization", namespace="AWS/EC2", period=300, statistic="Average", threshold=80, alarm_description="High CPU alert", dimensions={ "InstanceId": instance.id })' > alarm.py

instruction: Create an EventBridge rule for cron schedule
output: echo 'rule = aws.cloudwatch.EventRule("nightly", schedule_expression="cron(0 2 * * ? *)"); target = aws.cloudwatch.EventTarget("lambda", rule=rule.name, arn=fn.arn)' > eventbridge.py

instruction: Create an IAM role for cross-account access
output: echo 'role = aws.iam.Role("cross-account", assume_role_policy=json.dumps({"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}))' > cross-account.py

instruction: Create a VPC peering connection
output: echo 'peering = aws.ec2.VpcPeeringConnection("peer", vpc_id=vpc1.id, peer_vpc_id=vpc2.id, peer_region="eu-west-1"); route = aws.ec2.Route("peer-route", route_table_id=rtb1.id, destination_cidr_block=vpc2.cidr_block, vpc_peering_connection_id=peering.id)' > peering.py

instruction: Create an EC2 launch template for auto-scaling
output: echo 'lt = aws.ec2.LaunchTemplate("web", image_id=ami.id, instance_type="t3.micro", key_name="my-key", vpc_security_group_ids=[sg.id]); asg = aws.autoscaling.Group("web", launch_template=aws.autoscaling.GroupLaunchTemplateArgs(name=lt.name, version="\$Latest"), min_size=2, max_size=10, desired_capacity=2, vpc_zone_identifiers=[subnet.id])' > asg.py

instruction: Create an ECR lifecycle policy
output: echo 'policy = aws.ecr.LifecyclePolicy("cleanup", repository=repo.name, policy=json.dumps({"rules":[{"rulePriority":1,"description":"Expire old","selection":{"tagStatus":"any","countType":"imageCountMoreThan","countNumber":100},"action":{"type":"expire"}}]}))' > ecr.py

instruction: Create an ElastiCache replication group
output: echo 'group = aws.elasticache.ReplicationGroup("cache", replication_group_id="app-cache", engine="redis", engine_version="7.0", node_type="cache.t3.micro", num_cache_clusters=2, parameter_group_name="default.redis7", automatic_failover_enabled=True, subnet_group_name=subnet_group.name)' > elasticache.py

instruction: Create an EFS filesystem with mount targets
output: echo 'fs = aws.efs.FileSystem("data"); mt1 = aws.efs.MountTarget("az1", file_system_id=fs.id, subnet_id=subnet1.id, security_groups=[sg.id]); mt2 = aws.efs.MountTarget("az2", file_system_id=fs.id, subnet_id=subnet2.id, security_groups=[sg.id])' > efs.py

instruction: Create an API Gateway REST API
output: echo 'api = aws.apigateway.RestApi("api"); resource = aws.apigateway.Resource("proxy", rest_api=api.id, parent_id=api.root_resource_id, path_part="{proxy+}"); method = aws.apigateway.Method("any", rest_api=api.id, resource_id=resource.id, http_method="ANY", authorization="NONE"); integration = aws.apigateway.Integration("lambda", rest_api=api.id, resource_id=resource.id, http_method=method.http_method, type="AWS_PROXY", integration_http_method="POST", uri=fn.invoke_arn)' > apigw.py

instruction: Create an ACM certificate with DNS validation
output: echo 'cert = aws.acm.Certificate("www", domain_name="example.com", validation_method="DNS"); record = aws.route53.Record("validation", zone_id=zone.id, name=cert.domain_validation_options[0].resource_record_name, type=cert.domain_validation_options[0].resource_record_type, records=[cert.domain_validation_options[0].resource_record_value], ttl=60); validation = aws.acm.CertificateValidation("cert", certificate_arn=cert.arn, validation_record_fqdns=[record.fqdn])' > acm.py
